title: Empty / First-Run States
description: Clear empty states for a board with no columns, a column with no cards, and a first-run with no boards, guiding the user to the next action.
spec:
1. Render a helpful empty state when the active board has no columns
2. Render an empty drop area with guidance when a column has no cards
3. Render a first-run state (or default board) when there are no boards
4. Verify empty states disappear once content is added
